- anthropic-skills:consolidate-memory: Reflective pass over your memory files — merge duplicates, fix stale facts, prune the index.
- anthropic-skills:docx: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.
- anthropic-skills:pdf: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.
- anthropic-skills:pptx: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions "deck," "slides," "presentation," or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx or .potx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.
- anthropic-skills:schedule: Create or update a scheduled task that runs automatically. Use when the user says things like "every day", "each morning", "remind me in an hour", "run this at noon", or wants to reschedule an existing task.
- anthropic-skills:setup-cowork: Guided Cowork setup — install role-matched plugins, connect your tools, try a skill.
- anthropic-skills:skill-creator: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
- anthropic-skills:xlsx: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- verify: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by running the app and observing behavior. Use when asked to verify a PR, confirm a fix works, test a change manually, check that a feature works, or validate local changes before pushing.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring cloud agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. - run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). # KasirKu

POS kasir untuk F&B dan Retail. Next.js (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind) + Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage).

Migrasi dari prototype single-file HTML/localStorage — lihat referensi lengkap logika bisnis & rencana skema di [`docs/reference/`](docs/reference/).

## Struktur project

```
src/
  app/                  routes (App Router)
  lib/
    supabase/
      client.ts          Supabase client untuk Client Components (browser)
      server.ts           Supabase client untuk Server Components/Actions (cookies)
      middleware.ts        refresh session token, dipanggil dari src/proxy.ts
    types/
      database.ts          tipe hasil `supabase gen types typescript` (masih placeholder)
supabase/
  config.toml             konfigurasi Supabase CLI lokal
  migrations/              schema database, urut sesuai modul (lihat di bawah)
docs/
  reference/
    pos-system_1.html       prototype asli (referensi logika bisnis, JANGAN dijalankan sebagai app)
    skema-database-kasirku.md   dokumen perencanaan skema
```

## Setup

1. Install dependencies (sudah dijalankan saat scaffold, ulangi kalau clone baru):
   ```bash
   npm install
   ```
2. Buat project di [supabase.com](https://supabase.com/dashboard), lalu salin `.env.example` ke `.env.local` dan isi `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` dari Project Settings → API.
3. Link project lokal ke project Supabase yang baru dibuat:
   ```bash
   npx supabase login
   npx supabase link --project-ref <project-ref>
   ```
4. Jalankan migration ke database Supabase:
   ```bash
   npx supabase db push
   ```
   Atau, untuk development lokal dengan Docker (`supabase start` butuh Docker Desktop):
   ```bash
   npx supabase start
   npx supabase db reset   # apply semua migration ke instance lokal
   ```
5. Generate TypeScript types dari schema yang sudah jalan (menggantikan placeholder di `src/lib/types/database.ts`):
   ```bash
   npx supabase gen types typescript --project-id <project-ref> > src/lib/types/database.ts
   ```
6. Jalankan dev server:
   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```

## Urutan migration

Mengikuti urutan modul di `docs/reference/skema-database-kasirku.md`:

1. `20260702100000_extensions_and_helpers.sql` — extension pgcrypto, skema `private`, helper RLS `private.owns_business()`
2. `20260702100100_businesses_and_cashiers.sql` — fondasi auth & akses
3. `20260702100200_products_ingredients_recipes.sql` — data master
4. `20260702100300_shifts_and_transactions.sql` — inti operasional
5. `20260702100400_finance_tables.sql` — modul Keuangan
6. `20260702100500_fnb_support_tables.sql` — fitur pendukung F&B (juga menyambungkan FK `transactions.table_id` yang sengaja ditunda dari migration #4, karena tabel `tables` baru ada di sini)
7. `20260702100600_activity_log.sql` — log aktivitas

Setiap tabel dengan `business_id` diamankan dengan RLS lewat `private.owns_business(business_id)` — akses hanya untuk businesses milik `auth.uid()` yang sedang login. Tabel anak yang tidak punya `business_id` langsung (`product_recipes`, `transaction_items`, dll) diamankan lewat `EXISTS` join ke tabel induknya.

## Keputusan desain yang masih perlu diambil

Belum diimplementasikan di migration ini — perlu diputuskan sebelum modul terkait mulai di-porting:

- **Verifikasi PIN kasir**: RLS `cashiers` saat ini hanya mengizinkan `owner_id = auth.uid()` (pemilik akun) membaca `pin_hash`. Karena kasir individual tidak punya akun Supabase Auth sendiri (hanya pemilik bisnis yang login), verifikasi PIN sebaiknya lewat Postgres function (`security definer` RPC) yang menerima `cashier_id` + PIN plaintext dan mengembalikan boolean — supaya `pin_hash` tidak perlu ter-expose ke client sama sekali.
- **Self-order dari pelanggan (scan QR meja)**: pelanggan yang scan QR di meja tidak login sebagai pemilik bisnis, jadi policy `private.owns_business()` pada `self_orders`/`self_order_items` akan memblokir mereka melakukan INSERT. Perlu policy tambahan yang scoped ke `anon` role (misalnya izinkan INSERT kalau `table_id` valid & `self_orders.status = 'baru'`), atau proses lewat Edge Function dengan service role.
- **Tutup shift**: kalkulasi `cash_sales`/`non_cash_sales`/`total_sales`/`expected_cash`/`difference` sebaiknya jadi Postgres function (RPC) supaya atomic, bukan dihitung di client lalu di-`UPDATE` — sesuai catatan di dokumen skema asli.

## INVESTIGATION REPORT: KasirKu Self-Order Feature

### 1. DATABASE SCHEMA — PLANNED vs ACTUAL

**Source:** `docs/reference/skema-database-kasirku.md` (lines 226-233) + `/supabase/migrations/20260702100500_fnb_support_tables.sql`

#### **`tables` (Meja self-order)**

| Column | Type | Constraints | Notes |
|--------|------|-----------|-------|
| `id` | `uuid` | PK, `default gen_random_uuid()` | |
| `business_id` | `uuid` | FK → `businesses` (cascade delete) | |
| `name` | `text` | NOT NULL | Display name for the table |
| `qr_slug` | `text` | NOT NULL, UNIQUE | Capability-based access token; random base64url string |

**Index:** `business_id`  
**RLS Policy:** `"Owner manages tables of own businesses"` — uses `private.owns_business(business_id)` helper function for all (select/insert/update/delete).

#### **`self_orders` (Customer self-order sessions)**

| Column | Type | Constraints | Notes |
|--------|------|-----------|-------|
| `id` | `uuid` | PK, `default gen_random_uuid()` | |
| `business_id` | `uuid` | FK → `businesses` (cascade delete) | |
| `table_id` | `uuid` | FK → `tables` (cascade delete), NOT NULL | Link to physical table |
| `status` | `text` | NOT NULL, default `'baru'`, CHECK IN (`'baru'`, `'diproses'`, `'selesai'`) | Order state: new → processing → completed |
| `created_at` | `timestamptz` | NOT NULL, default `now()` | |

**Indices:** `business_id`, `table_id`  
**RLS Policy:** `"Owner manages self orders of own businesses"` — checks `private.owns_business(so.business_id)` for all operations.

#### **`self_order_items` (Line items within a self-order)**

| Column | Type | Constraints | Notes |
|--------|------|-----------|-------|
| `id` | `uuid` | PK, `default gen_random_uuid()` | |
| `self_order_id` | `uuid` | FK → `self_orders` (cascade delete), NOT NULL | Parent order |
| `product_id` | `uuid` | FK → `products` (set null on delete), nullable | Reference to product; nullable for orphaned historical records |
| `name` | `text` | NOT NULL | **Snapshot** of product name at order time |
| `price` | `numeric(12,2)` | NOT NULL | **Snapshot** of product price at order time |
| `qty` | `numeric(12,2)` | NOT NULL | Quantity ordered |
| `note` | `text` | nullable, max 200 chars | Customer special instructions (trimmed server-side) |

**Index:** `self_order_id`  
**RLS Policy:** `"Owner manages self order items of own businesses"` — checks existence of parent `self_orders` and `owns_business` for all operations (prevents direct item writes if order doesn't belong to business owner).

---

### 2. EXISTING RLS POLICIES

All three tables use **security definer functions** with row-level security enabled:

- **`tables`**: Controlled by `private.owns_business(business_id)` for owner-only access.
- **`self_orders`**: Controlled by `private.owns_business(business_id)` for owner-only access to their incoming orders.
- **`self_order_items`**: Controlled via existential check: `exists (select 1 from public.self_orders so where so.id = self_order_items.self_order_id and private.owns_business(so.business_id))` — ensures only the order's business owner can read/write items.

**Crucially:** These policies protect *owner/business access*. **There is NO direct RLS for anonymous customer access** — instead, access is controlled via two Postgres **security-definer functions** (lines 8-54 of `20260702101100_self_order_rpc.sql`) that grant `execute` permission to both `anon` and `authenticated`:
  - `get_self_order_menu(p_qr_slug text)` — returns menu for a given QR table slug
  - `submit_self_order(p_qr_slug text, p_items jsonb)` — submits order using QR slug as the capability

---

### 3. EXISTING SELF-ORDER CODE & UI

Self-order feature **already exists** (partially implemented). File inventory:

#### **Customer-Facing Pages:**
- **`src/app/order/[qrSlug]/page.tsx`** — Server component; fetches menu via `get_self_order_menu(qr_slug)` RPC; renders `OrderScreen`.
- **`src/app/order/[qrSlug]/order-screen.tsx`** — Client component; cart UI, product selection, quantity adjustment, notes, submit button.
- **`src/app/order/[qrSlug]/actions.ts`** — Server action; calls `submit_self_order(qr_slug, items)` RPC to create order.

#### **Business Owner Pages:**
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/tables/page.tsx`** — List meja, display incoming orders (status != 'selesai'), manage table QR codes.
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/tables/actions.ts`**:
  - `addTable(businessId, formData)` — Create new table with random `qr_slug`.
  - `deleteTable(businessId, tableId)` — Delete table.
  - `setSelfOrderStatus(businessId, orderId, status)` — Update order status ('diproses' or 'selesai').
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/tables/copy-link-button.tsx`** — UI to copy order link.
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/tables/order-status-button.tsx`** — UI to change order status.
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/tables/delete-table-button.tsx`** — UI to delete table.
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/tables/add-table-form.tsx`** — Form to add new table.

#### **POS Integration:**
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/page.tsx`** (lines 156–166) — Fetches active self-orders for FNB businesses; filters status != 'selesai'; passes to POS screen.
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/pos-screen.tsx`** (lines 38–50, 132–141) — Displays self-order inbox as a tabbed notification. Polls `router.refresh()` every 15 seconds for F&B to check for new orders.
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/actions.ts`** — `updateSelfOrderStatus()` server action (implemented in table actions, not shown in this excerpt).

#### **Prototype Reference:**
- **`docs/reference/pos-system_1.html`** (lines ~381–384, ~959–961, ~2122–2157, ~5461–5806) — Old single-file prototype had:
  - Self-order toggle UI
  - QR code modal generation
  - "Pesan dari meja" (orders from table) inbox
  - Table management (add/delete/show QR)
  - Automatic open bill creation for self-orders
  - Barcode scanner code structure (`html5-qrcode`)

---

### 4. AUTHENTICATION & ANONYMOUS ACCESS

#### **Current Auth Architecture:**

**Middleware** (`src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts`, lines 40–43):
- Routes `/order/*` are explicitly marked as **public** (no login required).
- Routes `/auth/callback` are public (email link exchange).
- All other routes (`/business/*`, `/dashboard`, etc.) require authenticated user.

**Supabase Clients:**
- **`src/lib/supabase/client.ts`** — Browser client; uses `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` only.
- **`src/lib/supabase/server.ts`** — Server client; also uses `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` (no separate service key visible).

**Anonymous vs Authenticated Access:**
- **Anon users**: Middleware allows `/order/*` routes; client SDK automatically runs as `auth.uid() = null`.
- **Authenticated users**: Business owners log in via `/login`; session stored in cookies; all business routes require RLS `owns_business()` check.
- **Self-order RPC functions** (`get_self_order_menu`, `submit_self_order`) are explicitly **granted to `anon` and `authenticated`** (line 56, 131 of migration file). These functions use `security definer` to operate with elevated privileges based on the valid `qr_slug` parameter as a capability.

**No separate anon key:** The project uses a single `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` for all access. RLS policies and security-definer functions enforce access control.

---

### 5. EXISTING POS TRANSACTION FLOW & CONVENTIONS

#### **Flow Overview:**

1. **Page load** (`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/page.tsx`):
   - Authenticates cashier session (PIN screen if not logged in).
   - Fetches products, open bills, customers, self-orders.
   - Passes data to client component.

2. **Client-side cart** (`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/pos-screen.tsx`):
   - State: `CartItem[]` (product ID, qty, discount per item, price).
   - User adds/removes items, adjusts quantities, applies item-level or order-level discounts.
   - Calculates totals via `calculateCheckoutTotals()` helper.

3. **Server action checkout** (`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/actions.ts`, line 68–99):
   - Calls RPC `checkout_transaction(business_id, cashier_id, items, payment_method, received, ...)`.
   - RPC is **atomic** — creates transaction, items, payment record, decrements stock in one function.
   - RPC **snapshots prices/names** from `products` table server-side (never trusts client).
   - Returns `{ transaction_id, invoice_number }`.
   - Action returns `{ success: true, invoiceNumber, transactionId }` or error.

#### **TypeScript Types:**

**`CartItem`** (client-side):
```typescript
type CartItem = {
  productId: string;
  name: string;
  price: number;
  qty: number;
  maxStock: number;
  disc: number;
  discType: DiscountType;
};
```

**`Product`** (from DB):
```typescript
type Product = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: string | null;
  price: number;
  cost: number;
  stock: number;
  emoji: string | null;
};
```

**`SelfOrderRow`** (from DB, in POS page):
```typescript
type SelfOrderRow = {
  id: string;
  status: "baru" | "diproses";
  created_at: string;
  tables: { name: string } | null;
  self_order_items: {
    product_id: string | null;
    name: string;
    qty: number;
    price: number;
    note: string | null;
  }[];
};
```

**Database types** (`src/lib/types/database.ts`):
- **Currently a placeholder** — not yet generated from real schema. Comment notes: regenerate after migrations are applied using `npx supabase gen types typescript --project-id <ref>`.

#### **Conventions:**

- **Server actions** for mutations (checkout, update status, save bill). Use `revalidatePath()` to refresh server state.
- **Form handling** via `FormData` in server actions (see `addTable` in tables actions).
- **Polling for real-time updates:** Client-side `useEffect` calls `router.refresh()` on an interval (e.g., POS screen refreshes every 15s for F&B orders).
- **Error handling** in server actions: return `{ success: false; error: string }` for user-facing errors.
- **RPC calls** instead of direct table inserts for complex, atomic operations (checkout, self-order submit, PIN verification).
- **Snapshot values** for historical data (product name/price copied at order time, not referenced).

---

### 6. DATABASE TYPES STATUS

**File:** `src/lib/types/database.ts`

**Current state:** **Placeholder only** — `export type Database = Record<string, never>;`

**Comment in file:**
```
Regenerate after migrations are applied to a real project:
  npx supabase gen types typescript --project-id <ref> > src/lib/types/database.ts
```

**Status of self-order types:** `tables`, `self_orders`, `self_order_items` types do **not exist yet** in the generated types file. Once regenerated, they will be auto-generated from the schema.

---

### 7. PROTOTYPE REFERENCE (pos-system_1.html)

**File:** `docs/reference/pos-system_1.html`

**Self-order/QR/table references found:**

- **Lines 144, 381–384:** Self-order inbox button with notification badge (`self-order-badge`).
- **Lines 959–961:** Self-order toggle UI in settings; description: "Pelanggan scan QR di meja untuk lihat menu & pesan langsung dari HP mereka".
- **Lines 966:** Input field for new table name.
- **Lines 2122–2157:** QR code modal (`qr-table-modal`, `self-order-inbox-modal`); QR code canvas wrapper, URL display, inbox list.
- **Lines 5461–5806:** JavaScript logic:
  - `_qrTableId`, `_tmTableId` variables for tracking table state.
  - `showQRForTable()`, `copyTableQRLink()`, `deleteTable()` functions.
  - `openSelfOrderInbox()`, `closeSelfOrderInbox()` UI functions.
  - `renderSelfOrderList()` to display incoming orders.
  - Automatic open bill creation for self-orders with table name.
  - Integration with HTML5-QRCode scanner library (line 8).

**Design patterns already in prototype:**
- QR slug as URL parameter for customer access.
- Status transitions: "baru" → "diproses" → "selesai".
- Kitchen printer integration for self-orders.
- Inbox polling model (check for new orders).

---

| Aspect | Status | Details |

| **Schema** | Complete | `tables`, `self_orders`, `self_order_items` fully defined with RLS. Deferred FK from `transactions.table_id` wired after table creation. |

#### **`self_orders` (Customer self-order sessions)**

| Column | Type | Constraints | Notes |
|--------|------|-----------|-------|
| `id` | `uuid` | PK, `default gen_random_uuid()` | |
| `business_id` | `uuid` | FK → `businesses` (cascade delete) | |
| `table_id` | `uuid` | FK → `tables` (cascade delete), NOT NULL | Link to physical table |
| `status` | `text` | NOT NULL, default `'baru'`, CHECK IN (`'baru'`, `'diproses'`, `'selesai'`) | Order state: new → processing → completed |
| `created_at` | `timestamptz` | NOT NULL, default `now()` | |

**Indices:** `business_id`, `table_id`  
**RLS Policy:** `"Owner manages self orders of own businesses"` — checks `private.owns_business(so.business_id)` for all operations.

#### **`self_order_items` (Line items within a self-order)**

| Column | Type | Constraints | Notes |
|--------|------|-----------|-------|
| `id` | `uuid` | PK, `default gen_random_uuid()` | |
| `self_order_id` | `uuid` | FK → `self_orders` (cascade delete), NOT NULL | Parent order |
| `product_id` | `uuid` | FK → `products` (set null on delete), nullable | Reference to product; nullable for orphaned historical records |
| `name` | `text` | NOT NULL | **Snapshot** of product name at order time |
| `price` | `numeric(12,2)` | NOT NULL | **Snapshot** of product price at order time |
| `qty` | `numeric(12,2)` | NOT NULL | Quantity ordered |
| `note` | `text` | nullable, max 200 chars | Customer special instructions (trimmed server-side) |

**Index:** `self_order_id`  
**RLS Policy:** `"Owner manages self order items of own businesses"` — checks existence of parent `self_orders` and `owns_business` for all operations (prevents direct item writes if order doesn't belong to business owner).

---

### 2. EXISTING RLS POLICIES

All three tables use **security definer functions** with row-level security enabled:

- **`tables`**: Controlled by `private.owns_business(business_id)` for owner-only access.
- **`self_orders`**: Controlled by `private.owns_business(business_id)` for owner-only access to their incoming orders.
- **`self_order_items`**: Controlled via existential check: `exists (select 1 from public.self_orders so where so.id = self_order_items.self_order_id and private.owns_business(so.business_id))` — ensures only the order's business owner can read/write items.

**Crucially:** These policies protect *owner/business access*. **There is NO direct RLS for anonymous customer access** — instead, access is controlled via two Postgres **security-definer functions** (lines 8-54 of `20260702101100_self_order_rpc.sql`) that grant `execute` permission to both `anon` and `authenticated`:
  - `get_self_order_menu(p_qr_slug text)` — returns menu for a given QR table slug
  - `submit_self_order(p_qr_slug text, p_items jsonb)` — submits order using QR slug as the capability

---

### 3. EXISTING SELF-ORDER CODE & UI

Self-order feature **already exists** (partially implemented). File inventory:

#### **Customer-Facing Pages:**
- **`src/app/order/[qrSlug]/page.tsx`** — Server component; fetches menu via `get_self_order_menu(qr_slug)` RPC; renders `OrderScreen`.
- **`src/app/order/[qrSlug]/order-screen.tsx`** — Client component; cart UI, product selection, quantity adjustment, notes, submit button.
- **`src/app/order/[qrSlug]/actions.ts`** — Server action; calls `submit_self_order(qr_slug, items)` RPC to create order.

#### **Business Owner Pages:**
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/tables/page.tsx`** — List meja, display incoming orders (status != 'selesai'), manage table QR codes.
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/tables/actions.ts`**:
  - `addTable(businessId, formData)` — Create new table with random `qr_slug`.
  - `deleteTable(businessId, tableId)` — Delete table.
  - `setSelfOrderStatus(businessId, orderId, status)` — Update order status ('diproses' or 'selesai').
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/tables/copy-link-button.tsx`** — UI to copy order link.
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/tables/order-status-button.tsx`** — UI to change order status.
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/tables/delete-table-button.tsx`** — UI to delete table.
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/tables/add-table-form.tsx`** — Form to add new table.

#### **POS Integration:**
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/page.tsx`** (lines 156–166) — Fetches active self-orders for FNB businesses; filters status != 'selesai'; passes to POS screen.
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/pos-screen.tsx`** (lines 38–50, 132–141) — Displays self-order inbox as a tabbed notification. Polls `router.refresh()` every 15 seconds for F&B to check for new orders.
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/actions.ts`** — `updateSelfOrderStatus()` server action (implemented in table actions, not shown in this excerpt).

#### **Prototype Reference:**
- **`docs/reference/pos-system_1.html`** (lines ~381–384, ~959–961, ~2122–2157, ~5461–5806) — Old single-file prototype had:
  - Self-order toggle UI
  - QR code modal generation
  - "Pesan dari meja" (orders from table) inbox
  - Table management (add/delete/show QR)
  - Automatic open bill creation for self-orders
  - Barcode scanner code structure (`html5-qrcode`)

---

### 4. AUTHENTICATION & ANONYMOUS ACCESS

#### **Current Auth Architecture:**

**Middleware** (`src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts`, lines 40–43):
- Routes `/order/*` are explicitly marked as **public** (no login required).
- Routes `/auth/callback` are public (email link exchange).
- All other routes (`/business/*`, `/dashboard`, etc.) require authenticated user.

**Supabase Clients:**
- **`src/lib/supabase/client.ts`** — Browser client; uses `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` only.
- **`src/lib/supabase/server.ts`** — Server client; also uses `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` (no separate service key visible).

**Anonymous vs Authenticated Access:**
- **Anon users**: Middleware allows `/order/*` routes; client SDK automatically runs as `auth.uid() = null`.
- **Authenticated users**: Business owners log in via `/login`; session stored in cookies; all business routes require RLS `owns_business()` check.
- **Self-order RPC functions** (`get_self_order_menu`, `submit_self_order`) are explicitly **granted to `anon` and `authenticated`** (line 56, 131 of migration file). These functions use `security definer` to operate with elevated privileges based on the valid `qr_slug` parameter as a capability.

**No separate anon key:** The project uses a single `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` for all access. RLS policies and security-definer functions enforce access control.

---

### 5. EXISTING POS TRANSACTION FLOW & CONVENTIONS

#### **Flow Overview:**

1. **Page load** (`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/page.tsx`):
   - Authenticates cashier session (PIN screen if not logged in).
   - Fetches products, open bills, customers, self-orders.
   - Passes data to client component.

2. **Client-side cart** (`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/pos-screen.tsx`):
   - State: `CartItem[]` (product ID, qty, discount per item, price).
   - User adds/removes items, adjusts quantities, applies item-level or order-level discounts.
   - Calculates totals via `calculateCheckoutTotals()` helper.

3. **Server action checkout** (`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/actions.ts`, line 68–99):
   - Calls RPC `checkout_transaction(business_id, cashier_id, items, payment_method, received, ...)`.
   - RPC is **atomic** — creates transaction, items, payment record, decrements stock in one function.
   - RPC **snapshots prices/names** from `products` table server-side (never trusts client).
   - Returns `{ transaction_id, invoice_number }`.
   - Action returns `{ success: true, invoiceNumber, transactionId }` or error.

#### **TypeScript Types:**

**`CartItem`** (client-side):
```typescript
type CartItem = {
  productId: string;
  name: string;
  price: number;
  qty: number;
  maxStock: number;
  disc: number;
  discType: DiscountType;
};
```

**`Product`** (from DB):
```typescript
type Product = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: string | null;
  price: number;
  cost: number;
  stock: number;
  emoji: string | null;
};
```

**`SelfOrderRow`** (from DB, in POS page):
```typescript
type SelfOrderRow = {
  id: string;
  status: "baru" | "diproses";
  created_at: string;
  tables: { name: string } | null;
  self_order_items: {
    product_id: string | null;
    name: string;
    qty: number;
    price: number;
    note: string | null;
  }[];
};
```

**Database types** (`src/lib/types/database.ts`):
- **Currently a placeholder** — not yet generated from real schema. Comment notes: regenerate after migrations are applied using `npx supabase gen types typescript --project-id <ref>`.

#### **Conventions:**

- **Server actions** for mutations (checkout, update status, save bill). Use `revalidatePath()` to refresh server state.
- **Form handling** via `FormData` in server actions (see `addTable` in tables actions).
- **Polling for real-time updates:** Client-side `useEffect` calls `router.refresh()` on an interval (e.g., POS screen refreshes every 15s for F&B orders).
- **Error handling** in server actions: return `{ success: false; error: string }` for user-facing errors.
- **RPC calls** instead of direct table inserts for complex, atomic operations (checkout, self-order submit, PIN verification).
- **Snapshot values** for historical data (product name/price copied at order time, not referenced).

---

### 6. DATABASE TYPES STATUS

**File:** `src/lib/types/database.ts`

**Current state:** **Placeholder only** — `export type Database = Record<string, never>;`

**Comment in file:**
```
Regenerate after migrations are applied to a real project:
  npx supabase gen types typescript --project-id <ref> > src/lib/types/database.ts
```

**Status of self-order types:** `tables`, `self_orders`, `self_order_items` types do **not exist yet** in the generated types file. Once regenerated, they will be auto-generated from the schema.

---

### 7. PROTOTYPE REFERENCE (pos-system_1.html)

**File:** `docs/reference/pos-system_1.html`

**Self-order/QR/table references found:**

- **Lines 144, 381–384:** Self-order inbox button with notification badge (`self-order-badge`).
- **Lines 959–961:** Self-order toggle UI in settings; description: "Pelanggan scan QR di meja untuk lihat menu & pesan langsung dari HP mereka".
- **Lines 966:** Input field for new table name.
- **Lines 2122–2157:** QR code modal (`qr-table-modal`, `self-order-inbox-modal`); QR code canvas wrapper, URL display, inbox list.
- **Lines 5461–5806:** JavaScript logic:
  - `_qrTableId`, `_tmTableId` variables for tracking table state.
  - `showQRForTable()`, `copyTableQRLink()`, `deleteTable()` functions.
  - `openSelfOrderInbox()`, `closeSelfOrderInbox()` UI functions.
  - `renderSelfOrderList()` to display incoming orders.
  - Automatic open bill creation for self-orders with table name.
  - Integration with HTML5-QRCode scanner library (line 8).

**Design patterns already in prototype:**
- QR slug as URL parameter for customer access.
- Status transitions: "baru" → "diproses" → "selesai".
- Kitchen printer integration for self-orders.
- Inbox polling model (check for new orders).

---

## SUMMARY FOR IMPLEMENTATION PLANNING

| Aspect | Status | Details |
|--------|--------|---------|
| **Schema** | Complete | `tables`, `self_orders`, `self_order_items` fully defined with RLS. Deferred FK from `transactions.table_id` wired after table creation. |
| **RPC Functions** | Complete | `get_self_order_menu()` and `submit_self_order()` in place with security-definer; granted to anon. |

| **Auth Flow** | Working | Anonymous `/order/*` routes + authenticated `/business/*` routes correctly separated; RLS enforces ownership. |
| **Types** | Missing | Database types not yet generated from real schema; placeholder only. |
| **Code Patterns** | Established | Server actions, RPC calls, snapshot values, polling for updates — all demonstrated in existing checkout flow. |

**Next steps would typically be:**
1. Generate real types from Supabase schema.
2. Wire self-order → transaction creation in checkout flow (when cashier finalizes a self-order's bill).
3. Add real-time updates (WebSocket/live-query or more frequent polling).

Hasil eksplorasi menunjukkan sesuatu yang penting: **fitur self-order via QR ternyata sudah diimplementasikan lengkap** — catatan di README ("belum diimplementasikan") sudah usang/tidak akurat. Ini yang saya temukan:

**Sudah ada dan berfungsi end-to-end:**
- Migration `20260702100500_fnb_support_tables.sql` — skema `tables`, `self_orders`, `self_order_items` lengkap dengan RLS pemilik bisnis
- Migration `20260702101100_self_order_rpc.sql` — dua RPC `security definer` (`get_self_order_menu`, `submit_self_order`) yang di-grant ke role `anon` — inilah cara akses pelanggan tanpa login diamankan, bukan lewat RLS policy langsung
- Halaman pelanggan: `src/app/order/[qrSlug]/page.tsx` + `order-screen.tsx` + `actions.ts` — scan QR, lihat menu, submit pesanan
- Halaman pemilik: `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/tables/` — kelola meja, generate QR link, lihat status pesanan masuk
- Integrasi POS: `pos-screen.tsx` punya inbox self-order (polling refresh 15 detik), tombol "tambah ke keranjang" (`handleAddOrderToCart`) yang memindahkan item pesanan meja ke cart kasir untuk di-checkout, sekaligus set status jadi `diproses` dan dispatch ke printer dapur
- Middleware sudah expose `/order/*` sebagai route publik (tanpa login)

**Gap kecil yang saya lihat (bukan "belum ada", tapi bisa dirapikan):**
- Saat kasir checkout order dari meja, status self_order tidak otomatis di-set `selesai`, dan transaksi hasil checkout tidak di-link balik ke `self_order_id`/`table_id` untuk histori — jadi tidak ada jejak "pesanan meja mana jadi transaksi mana"

Karena fiturnya sudah ada, mending saya tidak membangun ulang. Mau saya:

The KasirKu project uses a hosted Supabase project (URL in `.env.local`), but `npx supabase migration list --linked` fails with LegacyProjectNotLinkedError — the CLI is not linked on this machine.

**Why:** New files in `supabase/migrations/` do not reach the database automatically; features silently fall back (e.g. missing RPCs return null) until applied.

**How to apply:** After adding a migration, remind the user (m.khamdannn91@gmail.com) to paste its SQL into the Supabase dashboard SQL Editor. CSV export columns). `20260703120000_open_bills.sql` was applied by the user the same day (save/update/load/pay-deletes cycle verified E2E). All migrations through 20260703120000 are applied. 1. Pelanggan scan QR → halaman `/order/CWsFCMmosD7O` tampil menu toko ✅

3. Kasir login → badge "🛎️ Order 1" muncul realtime di POS ✅

Satu-satunya masalah yang saya temui saat testing adalah tab preview browser sempat menyangkut di `/login` karena stale render sebelum dev server siap — bukan bug aplikasi (curl langsung ke server menunjukkan halaman order render normal dari awal).

**Jadi status sebenarnya:** README perlu diperbarui — bagian "belum diimplementasikan" untuk self-order sudah usang. Mau saya perbaiki README-nya sekarang (hapus/update poin #2, dan sekalian catat gap kecil: transaksi checkout belum di-link balik ke `self_order_id`/`table_id` untuk histori)?

**Selesai diimplementasikan**, dengan satu langkah manual yang masih perlu Anda lakukan:

**Perubahan kode:**
- `supabase/migrations/20260708100000_link_self_order_checkout.sql` — `checkout_transaction` RPC sekarang menerima `p_self_order_ids uuid[]`: menandai self_order jadi `selesai` dan mengisi `transactions.table_id` (kolom yang sudah ada di skema tapi belum pernah diisi sejak awal)
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/actions.ts` — `checkout()` meneruskan `selfOrderIds` ke RPC
- `pos-screen.tsx` — melacak self_order id yang ditambahkan ke keranjang (`cartOrderIds`), dikirim saat bayar, direset setelah bayar/simpan bon

**Verifikasi di browser:** alur QR → inbox → tambah ke keranjang berfungsi sempurna. Saat klik "Konfirmasi Pembayaran", muncul error yang mengonfirmasi migration belum ter-apply ke Supabase remote:
```
Could not find the function public.checkout_transaction(...p_self_order_ids) in the schema cache
```
Ini sesuai ekspektasi — kodenya benar, tapi RPC di database remote masih versi lama.

**Yang perlu Anda lakukan:** paste isi `supabase/migrations/20260708100000_link_self_order_checkout.sql` ke Supabase Dashboard → SQL Editor lalu jalankan. Setelah itu alur checkout dari self-order akan otomatis menutup pesanan meja dan mencatat `table_id` di transaksi. Type-check dan 38 unit test tetap hijau setelah perubahan ini.

Setiap tabel dengan `business_id` diamankan dengan RLS lewat `private.owns_business(business_id)` — akses hanya untuk businesses milik `auth.uid()` yang sedang login. Tabel anak yang tidak punya `business_id` langsung (`product_recipes`, `transaction_items`, dll) diamankan lewat `EXISTS` join ke tabel induknya.

## Keputusan desain yang masih perlu diambil

Belum diimplementasikan di migration ini — perlu diputuskan sebelum modul terkait mulai di-porting:

- **Verifikasi PIN kasir**: RLS `cashiers` saat ini hanya mengizinkan `owner_id = auth.uid()` (pemilik akun) membaca `pin_hash`. Karena kasir individual tidak punya akun Supabase Auth sendiri (hanya pemilik bisnis yang login), verifikasi PIN sebaiknya lewat Postgres function (`security definer` RPC) yang menerima `cashier_id` + PIN plaintext dan mengembalikan boolean — supaya `pin_hash` tidak perlu ter-expose ke client sama sekali.
- **Self-order dari pelanggan (scan QR meja)**: pelanggan yang scan QR di meja tidak login sebagai pemilik bisnis, jadi policy `private.owns_business()` pada `self_orders`/`self_order_items` akan memblokir mereka melakukan INSERT. Perlu policy tambahan yang scoped ke `anon` role (misalnya izinkan INSERT kalau `table_id` valid & `self_orders.status = 'baru'`), atau proses lewat Edge Function dengan service role.
- **Tutup shift**: kalkulasi `cash_sales`/`non_cash_sales`/`total_sales`/`expected_cash`/`difference` sebaiknya jadi Postgres function (RPC) supaya atomic, bukan dihitung di client lalu di-`UPDATE` — sesuai catatan di dokumen skema asli.

53	create or replace function public.close_shift(
54	  p_shift_id uuid,
55	  p_closing_cash numeric,
56	  p_close_notes text default null
57	)
58	returns table (
59	  cash_sales numeric,
60	  non_cash_sales numeric,
61	  total_sales numeric,
62	  expected_cash numeric,
63	  difference numeric,
64	  tx_count int,
65	  void_count int
66	)
67	language plpgsql
68	security definer
69	set search_path = ''
70	as $$
71	declare
72	  v_business_id uuid;
73	  v_opening_cash numeric(12, 2);
74	  v_cash_sales numeric(12, 2) := 0;
75	  v_non_cash_sales numeric(12, 2) := 0;
76	  v_tx_count int := 0;
77	  v_void_count int := 0;
78	begin
79	  select s.business_id, s.opening_cash into v_business_id, v_opening_cash
80	  from public.shifts s
81	  where s.id = p_shift_id and s.closed_at is null;
82	
83	  if not found then
84	    raise exception 'shift not found or already closed';
85	  end if;
86	
87	  if not private.owns_business(v_business_id) then
88	    raise exception 'not authorized';
89	  end if;
90	
91	  if p_closing_cash is null or p_closing_cash < 0 then
92	    raise exception 'invalid closing cash';
93	  end if;
94	
95	  select
96	    coalesce(sum(tp.amount) filter (where tp.method = 'Tunai'), 0),
97	    coalesce(sum(tp.amount) filter (where tp.method != 'Tunai'), 0)
98	  into v_cash_sales, v_non_cash_sales
99	  from public.transactions t
100	  join public.transaction_payments tp on tp.transaction_id = t.id
101	  where t.shift_id = p_shift_id and not t.voided;
102	
103	  select
104	    count(*) filter (where not t.voided),
105	    count(*) filter (where t.voided)
106	  into v_tx_count, v_void_count
107	  from public.transactions t
108	  where t.shift_id = p_shift_id;
109	
110	  update public.shifts s
111	  set closed_at = now(),
112	      closing_cash = p_closing_cash,
113	      close_notes = p_close_notes,
114	      cash_sales = v_cash_sales,
115	      non_cash_sales = v_non_cash_sales,
116	      total_sales = v_cash_sales + v_non_cash_sales,
117	      expected_cash = v_opening_cash + v_cash_sales,
118	      difference = p_closing_cash - (v_opening_cash + v_cash_sales),
119	      tx_count = v_tx_count,
120	      void_count = v_void_count
121	  where s.id = p_shift_id;
122	
123	  return query
124	  select
125	    v_cash_sales,
126	    v_non_cash_sales,
127	    v_cash_sales + v_non_cash_sales,
128	    v_opening_cash + v_cash_sales,
129	    p_closing_cash - (v_opening_cash + v_cash_sales),
130	    v_tx_count,
131	    v_void_count;
132	end;
133	$$;
134

create or replace function public.close_shift(
  p_shift_id uuid,
  p_closing_cash numeric,
  p_close_notes text default null
)
returns table (
  cash_sales numeric,
  non_cash_sales numeric,
  total_sales numeric,
  expected_cash numeric,
  difference numeric,
  tx_count int,
  void_count int
)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_business_id uuid;
  v_opening_cash numeric(12, 2);
  v_cash_sales numeric(12, 2) := 0;
  v_non_cash_sales numeric(12, 2) := 0;
  v_tx_count int := 0;
  v_void_count int := 0;
begin
  select s.business_id, s.opening_cash into v_business_id, v_opening_cash
  from public.shifts s
  where s.id = p_shift_id and s.closed_at is null;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'shift not found or already closed';
  end if;

  if not private.owns_business(v_business_id) then
    raise exception 'not authorized';
  end if;

  if p_closing_cash is null or p_closing_cash < 0 then
    raise exception 'invalid closing cash';
  end if;

  select
    coalesce(sum(tp.amount) filter (where tp.method = 'Tunai'), 0),
    coalesce(sum(tp.amount) filter (where tp.method != 'Tunai'), 0)
  into v_cash_sales, v_non_cash_sales
  from public.transactions t
  join public.transaction_payments tp on tp.transaction_id = t.id
  where t.shift_id = p_shift_id and not t.voided;

  select
    count(*) filter (where not t.voided),
    count(*) filter (where t.voided)
  into v_tx_count, v_void_count
  from public.transactions t
  where t.shift_id = p_shift_id;

  update public.shifts s
  set closed_at = now(),
      closing_cash = p_closing_cash,
      close_notes = p_close_notes,
      cash_sales = v_cash_sales,
      non_cash_sales = v_non_cash_sales,
      total_sales = v_cash_sales + v_non_cash_sales,
      expected_cash = v_opening_cash + v_cash_sales,
      difference = p_closing_cash - (v_opening_cash + v_cash_sales),
      tx_count = v_tx_count,
      void_count = v_void_count
  where s.id = p_shift_id;

  return query
  select
    v_cash_sales,
    v_non_cash_sales,
    v_cash_sales + v_non_cash_sales,
    v_opening_cash + v_cash_sales,
    p_closing_cash - (v_opening_cash + v_cash_sales),
    v_tx_count,
    v_void_count;
end;
$$;

# KasirKu

POS kasir untuk F&B dan Retail. Next.js (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind) + Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage).

Migrasi dari prototype single-file HTML/localStorage — lihat referensi lengkap logika bisnis & rencana skema di [`docs/reference/`](docs/reference/).

## Struktur project

```
src/
  app/                  routes (App Router)
  lib/
    supabase/
      client.ts          Supabase client untuk Client Components (browser)
      server.ts           Supabase client untuk Server Components/Actions (cookies)
      middleware.ts        refresh session token, dipanggil dari src/proxy.ts
    types/
      database.ts          tipe hasil `supabase gen types typescript` (masih placeholder)
supabase/
  config.toml             konfigurasi Supabase CLI lokal
  migrations/              schema database, urut sesuai modul (lihat di bawah)
docs/
  reference/
    pos-system_1.html       prototype asli (referensi logika bisnis, JANGAN dijalankan sebagai app)
    skema-database-kasirku.md   dokumen perencanaan skema
```

## Setup

1. Install dependencies (sudah dijalankan saat scaffold, ulangi kalau clone baru):
   ```bash
   npm install
   ```
2. Buat project di [supabase.com](https://supabase.com/dashboard), lalu salin `.env.example` ke `.env.local` dan isi `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` dari Project Settings → API.
3. Link project lokal ke project Supabase yang baru dibuat:
   ```bash
   npx supabase login
   npx supabase link --project-ref <project-ref>
   ```
4. Jalankan migration ke database Supabase:
   ```bash
   npx supabase db push
   ```
   Atau, untuk development lokal dengan Docker (`supabase start` butuh Docker Desktop):
   ```bash
   npx supabase start
   npx supabase db reset   # apply semua migration ke instance lokal
   ```
5. Generate TypeScript types dari schema yang sudah jalan (menggantikan placeholder di `src/lib/types/database.ts`):
   ```bash
   npx supabase gen types typescript --project-id <project-ref> > src/lib/types/database.ts
   ```
6. Jalankan dev server:
   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```

## Urutan migration

Mengikuti urutan modul di `docs/reference/skema-database-kasirku.md`:

1. `20260702100000_extensions_and_helpers.sql` — extension pgcrypto, skema `private`, helper RLS `private.owns_business()`
2. `20260702100100_businesses_and_cashiers.sql` — fondasi auth & akses
3. `20260702100200_products_ingredients_recipes.sql` — data master
4. `20260702100300_shifts_and_transactions.sql` — inti operasional
5. `20260702100400_finance_tables.sql` — modul Keuangan
6. `20260702100500_fnb_support_tables.sql` — fitur pendukung F&B (juga menyambungkan FK `transactions.table_id` yang sengaja ditunda dari migration #4, karena tabel `tables` baru ada di sini)
7. `20260702100600_activity_log.sql` — log aktivitas

Setiap tabel dengan `business_id` diamankan dengan RLS lewat `private.owns_business(business_id)` — akses hanya untuk businesses milik `auth.uid()` yang sedang login. Tabel anak yang tidak punya `business_id` langsung (`product_recipes`, `transaction_items`, dll) diamankan lewat `EXISTS` join ke tabel induknya.

## Keputusan desain yang masih perlu diambil

Belum diimplementasikan di migration ini — perlu diputuskan sebelum modul terkait mulai di-porting:

- **Verifikasi PIN kasir**: RLS `cashiers` saat ini hanya mengizinkan `owner_id = auth.uid()` (pemilik akun) membaca `pin_hash`. Karena kasir individual tidak punya akun Supabase Auth sendiri (hanya pemilik bisnis yang login), verifikasi PIN sebaiknya lewat Postgres function (`security definer` RPC) yang menerima `cashier_id` + PIN plaintext dan mengembalikan boolean — supaya `pin_hash` tidak perlu ter-expose ke client sama sekali.
- **Self-order dari pelanggan (scan QR meja)**: pelanggan yang scan QR di meja tidak login sebagai pemilik bisnis, jadi policy `private.owns_business()` pada `self_orders`/`self_order_items` akan memblokir mereka melakukan INSERT. Perlu policy tambahan yang scoped ke `anon` role (misalnya izinkan INSERT kalau `table_id` valid & `self_orders.status = 'baru'`), atau proses lewat Edge Function dengan service role.
- **Tutup shift**: kalkulasi `cash_sales`/`non_cash_sales`/`total_sales`/`expected_cash`/`difference` sebaiknya jadi Postgres function (RPC) supaya atomic, bukan dihitung di client lalu di-`UPDATE` — sesuai catatan di dokumen skema asli.

README sudah diperbarui. Ringkasan status proyek sekarang:

**Semua 3 "keputusan desain belum diambil" yang tercatat di README ternyata sudah diimplementasikan:**

Tidak ada lagi item terbuka dari daftar itu. Kalau mau saya bantu, saya bisa lakukan audit lain (misalnya cek modul tiket venue atau payroll untuk gap serupa), atau kita bisa berhenti di sini — silakan beri tahu langkah berikutnya.

**Halaman Login/Signup/Forgot/Reset Password** (komponen bersama `AuthShell`):
- Panel brand hijau dengan gradient di sisi kiri (desktop) — headline, 4 fitur unggulan dengan ikon, pola dot-grid dekoratif

**Dashboard utama** (`/dashboard`):
- Header dengan avatar inisial + sapaan, bukan sekadar teks rata tengah
- Setiap kartu toko punya **aksen warna berbeda per jenis bisnis** (amber untuk F&B, biru untuk retail, ungu untuk tiket) — garis gradient di atas kartu, ikon avatar berwarna, badge jenis toko
- **Disederhanakan drastis**: dari ~15 link teks kecil per kartu jadi 2 tombol jelas — "🛎️ Buka Kasir" (primer) dan "Kelola →" (menuju dashboard per-toko yang sudah punya sidebar lengkap dengan semua menu, jadi tidak ada fitur yang hilang)

content.text:
Saya coba luruskan dulu supaya tidak salah paham — perubahan yang kita buat itu ada dua hal yang beda konteksnya:

1. **Fitur self-order (scan QR meja)** — ini yang kita buka aksesnya untuk "semua orang" (pelanggan), karena pelanggan yang scan QR memang tidak perlu login sama sekali. Ini cuma untuk alur pesan-menu dari meja.
2. **Halaman login/dashboard yang baru dirombak** — ini **tetap** butuh akun (email + password), karena di sana ada data sensitif toko (laporan keuangan, transaksi, dll). Ini sengaja tidak diubah jadi "bebas akses", dan memang belum pernah kita ubah levelnya.

Jadi soal role di aplikasi ini ada 3:
- **Pemilik toko** — punya akun email+password, login di `/login`, ini yang buka `/dashboard`
- **Kasir** — ditambahkan oleh pemilik, masuk pakai PIN (bukan email/password), cuma bisa akses POS
- **Pelanggan** — scan QR, tanpa login sama sekali

Pertanyaan saya: apakah Anda **sudah punya akun pemilik** untuk toko asli Anda (dari sebelum kita ngobrol ini), tapi lupa passwordnya? Atau **belum pernah bikin akun sama sekali**?

KasirKu is being developed as a SaaS-style product to be sold to other business owners (pelaku usaha) — it is not for the developer's (Melan's) own personal store. Confirmed 2026-07-08: Melan has never created an owner account in the app himself; his role is building/selling the system, not operating a store with it.

**Why:** changes the frame for future work — onboarding/signup flow, pricing/subscription, multi-tenant admin oversight, and marketing/landing pages matter here in a way they wouldn't for a single-owner internal tool.

**How to apply:** when working on auth, onboarding, or the root "/" experience, consider that the audience is prospective *customers* signing up for the first time, not one known owner. Currently there is no public marketing/landing page — `/` (`src/app/page.tsx`) just redirects straight to `/dashboard` (which the proxy then redirects to `/login` if unauthenticated). There is also no billing/subscription, plan limits, or super-admin panel for the seller to oversee all tenant businesses — flag these as likely-needed features rather than assuming out of scope. See [[test-account-preview]] for the throwaway test account used for browser verification (that account is not Melan's real account and is unrelated to any future customer-facing signup flow).

**Untuk lihat sebagai "pemilik" sekarang juga:** tinggal daftar akun baru sendiri di `http://localhost:3000/signup` — pakai email apa saja punya Anda, itu otomatis jadi akun pemilik toko pertama Anda (nanti diarahkan ke `/onboarding` untuk isi data toko). **Tapi karena ini produk yang mau dijual**, ada beberapa hal yang sebenarnya masih kosong dan biasanya penting untuk konteks itu:

- **Panel admin/superadmin** — untuk Anda sebagai penjual memantau semua toko yang pakai sistem ini, saat ini tidak ada

Berhasil masuk dashboard. Sekarang cek `/` saat sudah login — harus redirect otomatis ke dashboard, bukan tampil landing page.
Terkonfirmasi: **user yang sudah login → `/` otomatis redirect ke `/dashboard`** (tidak melihat landing page). User yang belum login akan melihat landing page baru.

**Halaman landing sudah jadi dan terverifikasi bekerja:**

- `/` sekarang dijadikan route publik di middleware (`src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts`) — sebelumnya langsung redirect ke login untuk siapapun yang belum login
- **Nav bar**: logo + "Masuk" + "Daftar Gratis"
- **Hero**: headline, CTA "Mulai Gratis" & "Lihat Fitur", plus mockup kartu dashboard dekoratif (bar chart, stat) di sisi kanan (desktop)
- **Jenis usaha**: 3 kartu F&B/Retail/Tiket dengan aksen warna yang sama seperti di dashboard (konsisten)
- **8 fitur unggulan** dalam grid (kasir, stok, self-order QR, laporan, kasir/shift, payroll, member, keamanan multi-toko)
- **CTA banner** gradient hijau tua di bawah + footer sederhana
- User yang **sudah login** tetap otomatis diarahkan ke `/dashboard` (tidak melihat landing page lagi)
- User yang **belum login** melihat landing page ini, bisa langsung klik "Daftar Gratis" → `/signup`

Type-check bersih, 38 unit test tetap hijau, semua navigasi (Daftar Gratis, redirect logged-in) sudah diverifikasi di browser.

Catatan jujur: saya sengaja **tidak** menambahkan testimoni palsu atau angka statistik ("1000+ pengguna", dsb.) karena itu belum benar — bisa ditambahkan nanti kalau sudah ada pengguna nyata.

-- Module 1: businesses, cashiers — foundation for auth & access.

create table public.businesses (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  owner_id uuid not null references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
  name text not null,
  business_type text not null check (business_type in ('fnb', 'retail')),
  address text,
  phone text,
  npwp text,
  logo_url text,
  tax_enabled boolean not null default false,
  tax_rate numeric(5, 2) not null default 0,
  service_enabled boolean not null default false,
  service_rate numeric(5, 2) not null default 0,
  auto_lock_enabled boolean not null default true,
  auto_lock_minutes int not null default 5,
  recovery_code_hash text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index businesses_owner_id_idx on public.businesses (owner_id);

alter table public.businesses enable row level security;

create policy "Owner has full access to own businesses"
on public.businesses for all
using (owner_id = auth.uid())
with check (owner_id = auth.uid());

-- Reusable RLS predicate: does the current user own the business that a row belongs to?
-- security definer + stable + fixed search_path so it can be inlined efficiently by the
-- planner and safely referenced from every table's RLS policy instead of repeating the
-- `business_id in (select id from businesses where owner_id = auth.uid())` subquery.
-- Defined here (not in the extensions migration) because it needs `businesses` to exist.
create or replace function private.owns_business(check_business_id uuid)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer
stable
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.businesses b
    where b.id = check_business_id
      and b.owner_id = auth.uid()
  );
$$;

-- Cashiers -------------------------------------------------------------

create table public.cashiers (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  name text not null,
  role text not null check (role in ('kasir', 'manajer')),
  pin_hash text not null,
  active boolean not null default true,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index cashiers_business_id_idx on public.cashiers (business_id);

alter table public.cashiers enable row level security;

create policy "Owner manages cashiers of own businesses"
on public.cashiers for all
using (private.owns_business(business_id))
with check (private.owns_business(business_id));

-- Superadmin panel (read-only overview across all tenants).
-- KasirKu is sold to multiple business owners; the seller needs a way to see
-- every registered toko and basic usage stats without going through each
-- tenant's own RLS-scoped view. Admins are seeded manually (paste a row into
-- this table via the Supabase SQL Editor) — there is no self-service signup
-- for this role by design.

create table public.admins (
  user_id uuid primary key references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

alter table public.admins enable row level security;
-- Intentionally no policies: this table is only ever read via the
-- security-definer functions below, never queried directly by clients.

create or replace function private.is_admin()
returns boolean
language sql
security definer
stable
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.admins a where a.user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$$;

-- Aggregate usage stats across every tenant.
create or replace function public.admin_stats()
returns table (
  total_businesses bigint,
  total_owners bigint,
  fnb_count bigint,
  retail_count bigint,
  tiket_count bigint,
  tx_today bigint,
  new_businesses_7d bigint
)
language plpgsql
security definer
stable
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if not private.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'not authorized';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    (select count(*) from public.businesses),
    (select count(distinct owner_id) from public.businesses),
    (select count(*) from public.businesses where business_type = 'fnb'),
    (select count(*) from public.businesses where business_type = 'retail'),
    (select count(*) from public.businesses where business_type = 'tiket'),
    (
      select
        coalesce((select count(*) from public.transactions where date::date = current_date and not voided), 0)
        + coalesce((select count(*) from public.ticket_transactions where date::date = current_date and not voided), 0)
    ),
    (select count(*) from public.businesses where created_at >= now() - interval '7 days');
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.admin_stats() to authenticated;

-- Full list of tenants with owner email and basic activity signals.
create or replace function public.admin_list_businesses()
returns table (
  id uuid,
  name text,
  business_type text,
  owner_email text,
  created_at timestamptz,
  shift_open boolean,
  tx_count bigint
)
language plpgsql
security definer
stable
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if not private.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'not authorized';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    b.id,
    b.name,
    b.business_type,
    u.email::text,
    b.created_at,
    exists (
      select 1 from public.shifts s
      where s.business_id = b.id and s.closed_at is null
    ),
    (
      coalesce((select count(*) from public.transactions t where t.business_id = b.id and not t.voided), 0)
      + coalesce((select count(*) from public.ticket_transactions tt where tt.business_id = b.id and not tt.voided), 0)
    )
  from public.businesses b
  join auth.users u on u.id = b.owner_id
  order by b.created_at desc;
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.admin_list_businesses() to authenticated;

content.text:
**Panel admin (read-only overview) sudah dibangun:**

**Database** (`supabase/migrations/20260708200000_admin_panel.sql`):
- Tabel `public.admins` (daftar user yang jadi superadmin) — RLS aktif tanpa policy sama sekali, jadi cuma bisa diakses lewat fungsi di bawah, tidak bisa di-query langsung dari client
- `private.is_admin()` — helper cek apakah user yang login adalah admin
- RPC `admin_stats()` — total toko, total pemilik, breakdown F&B/Retail/Tiket, transaksi hari ini (gabungan semua toko), toko baru 7 hari
- RPC `admin_list_businesses()` — daftar semua toko + email pemilik + status shift + total transaksi

**Halaman** `/admin` (`src/app/admin/page.tsx`) — header gelap (beda dari tampilan tenant biasa supaya jelas ini "mode admin"), kartu statistik, breakdown jenis usaha, tabel semua toko. Kalau yang akses bukan admin → tampil 404 biasa (bukan pesan "tidak diizinkan", supaya tidak membocorkan bahwa route ini ada).

Sudah diverifikasi: type-check bersih, 38 test hijau, dan `/admin` benar-benar mengembalikan 404 untuk akun non-admin (dites lewat fetch langsung ke server).

**Yang perlu Anda lakukan supaya bisa dipakai:**
1. Paste isi `supabase/migrations/20260708200000_admin_panel.sql` ke Supabase Dashboard → SQL Editor, jalankan
2. Cari user ID Anda di Dashboard → Authentication → Users (kolom UID)
3. Jalankan di SQL Editor: `insert into public.admins (user_id) values ('<uid-anda>');`

Setelah itu, akun Anda bisa buka `http://localhost:3000/admin` dan langsung lihat semua toko yang terdaftar. Sengaja tidak ada cara daftar jadi admin lewat UI — harus di-seed manual demi keamanan.

Saya sudah baca file-nya — ini ternyata cuma **shell/kerangka** dari aplikasi yang lebih besar ("Koenang Resto"), isi sebenarnya ada di file lain yang tidak ikut dikirim (`modules/akuntansi.html`, `modules/costcontrol.html`, `shared/*.js`). Tapi dari struktur sidebar-nya saya sudah bisa lihat jelas modul apa saja yang dimaksud.

**Yang sudah ada di KasirKu** (jadi tidak perlu dibangun ulang): Laporan & Laba Rugi, Payroll, Absensi, Kelola Produk/Bahan Baku, Riwayat Transaksi, Kas Harian (mirip modul Keuangan yang sudah ada), Kelola Kasir.

**Yang benar-benar baru / jadi gap "ERP"-nya**, ada 2 kelompok besar dan cukup berbeda sifatnya:

1. **Akuntansi double-entry** — Daftar Akun (COA), Jurnal Transaksi, Neraca, Laporan Arus Kas, Target vs Aktual. Ini pondasi akuntansi formal (debit/kredit per akun), jauh lebih kompleks dari Laba Rugi cash-basis yang sudah ada sekarang — perlu skema baru (chart of accounts, journal lines) dan keputusan besar: apakah ini **menggantikan** modul Laporan/Keuangan yang sudah ada, atau jadi lapisan tambahan di sampingnya?

2. **Cost Control & HPP** — Kalkulator HPP per resep, Tren Harga bahan baku, Cost Control (bandingkan pemakaian bahan aktual vs seharusnya), Laporan COGS. Ini nyambung langsung ke tabel yang **sudah ada** (`products`, `ingredients`, `product_recipes`), jadi risikonya lebih kecil dan nilainya langsung kepakai buat bisnis F&B yang sudah pakai KasirKu.

Temuan penting sebelum saya mulai coding: **fitur "Hitung HPP" ternyata sudah ada** — halaman resep per produk (`/products/[productId]/recipe`) sudah otomatis menghitung HPP dari bahan baku × qty setiap kali resep ditambah/dihapus (`recalculateProductCost` di `recipe/actions.ts`), dan langsung update `products.cost`. Jadi bagian "kalkulator HPP" dari referensi Anda sudah terpenuhi, cuma belum ada dashboard khusus untuk itu.

Yang **benar-benar belum ada** dari kelompok Cost Control & HPP:

1. **Laporan COGS** — breakdown HPP per produk/kategori dalam suatu periode (saat ini cuma muncul sebagai satu angka total di Laba Rugi)
2. **Cost Control (selisih pemakaian)** — bandingkan pemakaian bahan baku **teori** (dari resep × qty terjual) vs **aktual** (dari stok opname/`stock_adjustments` yang sudah ada) untuk mendeteksi bahan hilang/boros
3. **Tren Harga bahan baku** — ini butuh tabel baru karena `ingredients.unit_cost` cuma simpan harga saat ini, tidak ada riwayat perubahan harga

create or replace function public.void_transaction(
  p_business_id uuid,
  p_transaction_id uuid,
  p_manager_pin text,
  p_reason text default null
)
returns table (voided_by_name text)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_manager record;
  v_tx record;
begin
  if not private.owns_business(p_business_id) then
    raise exception 'not authorized';
  end if;

  -- Hanya PIN milik manajer aktif dari bisnis ini yang diterima. Pesan error
  -- sengaja tidak membedakan "PIN salah" vs "bukan manajer".
  select c.id, c.name
  into v_manager
  from public.cashiers c
  where c.business_id = p_business_id
    and c.role = 'manajer'
    and c.active
    and c.pin_hash = extensions.crypt(p_manager_pin, c.pin_hash)
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'PIN salah atau tidak memiliki otorisasi';
  end if;

  select t.id, t.voided
  into v_tx
  from public.transactions t
  where t.id = p_transaction_id
    and t.business_id = p_business_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'transaction not found';
  end if;

  if v_tx.voided then
    raise exception 'transaksi sudah dibatalkan';
  end if;

  -- Kembalikan stok produk yang terjual (produk yang sudah dihapus dilewati,
  -- sama seperti aplikasi lama).
  update public.products p
  set stock = p.stock + ti.qty
  from public.transaction_items ti
  where ti.transaction_id = p_transaction_id
    and ti.product_id = p.id
    and p.deleted_at is null;

  -- Kembalikan stok bahan baku yang terkonsumsi resep saat checkout.
  update public.ingredients i
  set stock = i.stock + tic.qty
  from public.transaction_ingredient_consumption tic
  where tic.transaction_id = p_transaction_id
    and tic.ingredient_id = i.id;

  update public.transactions
  set voided = true,
      voided_at = now(),
      void_reason = nullif(left(trim(p_reason), 200), ''),
      voided_by = v_manager.id
  where id = p_transaction_id;

  return query select v_manager.name;
end;
$$;

content.subject: Schema: accounts + journal_entries + journal_lines + seed COA
content.description: New migration: public.accounts (COA), public.journal_entries, public.journal_lines tables with RLS via private.owns_business(). Seed default Indonesian F&B/retail chart of accounts for new businesses (trigger on businesses insert) and backfill for existing businesses. Add private.post_journal(business_id, date, description, source, source_id, lines jsonb) plpgsql helper that validates debit=credit balance and inserts entry+lines atomically, plus a public.post_journal_entry(...) RPC wrapping it for manual entries from the client.

content.subject: Auto-post journal entries from checkout_transaction and void RPCs
content.description: Redefine checkout_transaction to call private.post_journal() for sales (debit kas/bank, credit pendapatan) and COGS (debit HPP beban, credit persediaan) when total_cost > 0. Redefine void_transaction_rpc to post a reversing entry referencing the original transaction's journal entry.
content.activeForm: Wiring sales/void auto-posting into checkout and void RPCs

content.subject: Auto-post journal entries from expense recording (finance/actions.ts)
content.description: After addExpense inserts into public.expenses, call the post_journal_entry RPC: purchases (bahan baku/barang dagang) debit Persediaan credit Kas; other expense categories debit mapped Beban account (fallback Beban Lain-lain) credit Kas. Map category name to account via a lookup table/const.

content.subject: Schema: budgets table for Target vs Aktual
content.description: New table public.budgets (business_id, account_id, period 'YYYY-MM', target_amount) with RLS, unique per business+account+period. Simple upsert action to set targets per account per month.

content.subject: UI: Daftar Akun + Jurnal Transaksi pages
content.description: New route group src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/accounting/ with daftar-akun (list COA, add custom account) and jurnal (list journal entries with drill-down to lines, manual entry form posting via post_journal_entry RPC).
content.activeForm: Building Daftar Akun and Jurnal pages

content.subject: UI: Neraca (Balance Sheet) page
content.description: accounting/neraca page.tsx: compute account balances as of a chosen date from journal_lines (sum debit-credit up to that date per account, sign per normal_balance), grouped by type (aset/kewajiban/modal), verify aset = kewajiban + modal.

content.subject: UI: Laporan Arus Kas page
content.description: accounting/arus-kas page.tsx: sum journal_lines touching Kas/Bank accounts within a period, grouped by journal_entries.source (penjualan=operasional in, pembelian/beban=operasional out, manual=lain-lain) into simplified operasional/investasi/pendanaan cash flow buckets.

content.subject: UI: Target vs Aktual (budget) page
content.description: accounting/anggaran page.tsx: form to set monthly target per account, table comparing target vs actual (from journal_lines) per account with variance %.

content.subject: Nav integration + verification
content.description: Add new "Akuntansi" nav group to dashboard-shell.tsx with links to all 5 accounting pages (fnb/retail only, hidden for tiket). Run tsc + vitest. Verify end-to-end in browser preview: create a sale, confirm journal auto-posted, check Neraca balances, check Arus Kas, set a budget target and see variance.

content.subject: Schema: accounts + journal_entries + journal_lines + seed COA
content.description: New migration: public.accounts (COA), public.journal_entries, public.journal_lines tables with RLS via private.owns_business(). Seed default Indonesian F&B/retail chart of accounts for new businesses (trigger on businesses insert) and backfill for existing businesses. Add private.post_journal(business_id, date, description, source, source_id, lines jsonb) plpgsql helper that validates debit=credit balance and inserts entry+lines atomically, plus a public.post_journal_entry(...) RPC wrapping it for manual entries from the client.

content.subject: Auto-post journal entries from checkout_transaction and void RPCs
content.description: Redefine checkout_transaction to call private.post_journal() for sales (debit kas/bank, credit pendapatan) and COGS (debit HPP beban, credit persediaan) when total_cost > 0. Redefine void_transaction_rpc to post a reversing entry referencing the original transaction's journal entry.

content.description: After addExpense inserts into public.expenses, call the post_journal_entry RPC: purchases (bahan baku/barang dagang) debit Persediaan credit Kas; other expense categories debit mapped Beban account (fallback Beban Lain-lain) credit Kas. Map category name to account via a lookup table/const.

**How to apply:** before building anything else from this reference, grep/read the relevant existing page first — this module has repeatedly turned out to already cover more than the sidebar-only feature list suggested. When resuming this work, next candidates in rough priority order: Tren Harga (small, additive), Supplier & Hutang / formal Pembelian.

**Akuntansi module — built 2026-07-08** (user explicitly chose auto-posting from transactions, and all 4 reports at once, overriding the "doesn't need to be complete" framing for this specific piece):
- Schema: `public.accounts` (Chart of Accounts, seeded per-business via trigger + backfill with a standard Indonesian F&B/retail COA — Kas & Bank, Persediaan, Utang Dagang, Modal Pemilik, Pendapatan Penjualan, Beban Pokok Penjualan, Beban Gaji/Sewa/Listrik/Marketing/Perlengkapan/Lain-lain), `public.journal_entries` + `public.journal_lines` (double-entry, journal tables are SELECT-only from the client — all writes go through `private.post_journal()` so an unbalanced entry can never be persisted), `public.budgets` (Target vs Aktual). See [[supabase-migrations-manual]] for the 3 pending migration files.
- Auto-posting wired into `checkout_transaction` (sales → debit Kas/Bank + credit Pendapatan, plus debit HPP/credit Persediaan when the sale has recipe cost data) and `void_transaction` (posts a reversing entry). Expense recording (`finance/actions.ts` → `addExpense`) also auto-posts via the new `post_journal_entry` RPC — purchases hit Persediaan, other categories map to a fixed category→account table (`EXPENSE_CATEGORY_ACCOUNT` in that file).
- Payroll does NOT auto-post yet — payslip actions still write directly to tables with no RPC, deliberately deferred rather than expanding this delivery further. If asked to close this gap, same pattern as the expense hook applies.
- 5 new pages under `/business/<id>/accounting/`: `daftar-akun` (CRUD custom accounts, system accounts can't be deleted), `jurnal` (period-filtered list + manual multi-line entry form with live debit=credit balance check), `neraca` (balance sheet as-of a date, with an unclosed "Laba Berjalan" line in Modal since there's no formal period-closing process — if aset≠kewajiban+modal it flags a visible warning), `arus-kas` (cash flow from the Kas & Bank account only, bucketed into Operasional vs "Investasi & Pendanaan (manual)"), `anggaran` (monthly budget per pendapatan/beban account vs actual from the journal). All wired into a new "Akuntansi" sidebar group in `dashboard-shell.tsx` (hidden for `tiket` business type, same as the existing Keuangan/Laporan group).
- Verified pre-migration: all 5 pages render gracefully with empty/zero state (no crashes) since none of them gate on the new tables existing — only real financial correctness (auto-posting, balance changes) remains to verify once the migrations are applied.

User wants KasirKu to grow toward a "mini ERP" (2026-07-08), modeled loosely on a reference prototype (`Koenang Resto` — a separate accounting + cost-control app, file at `D:\Users\ASTRI\Downloads\index.html`, an iframe shell only — actual module content in `modules/akuntansi.html`/`modules/costcontrol.html` was never shared). Explicit instruction: doesn't need to be complete, and must not disrupt the existing system — see [[project-purpose-saas-product]].

**Why:** the reference's sidebar reveals the target feature set even without the module internals: Akuntansi (COA/Jurnal/Neraca/Arus Kas/Target vs Aktual), Cost Control & HPP (kalkulator HPP, database bahan, cost control, laporan COGS, tren harga), Operasional (pembelian, stok, penjualan, invoice, kas harian, rekon rekening, supplier/hutang), SDM (absensi, payroll, lembur, THR, karyawan).

**Gap analysis against KasirKu's actual code (verified by reading source, not assumed):**
- Already covered, no rebuild needed: Laba Rugi (cash-basis, `reports/laba-rugi`), Payroll+Absensi, Kelola Produk/Bahan Baku, Riwayat Transaksi, Kelola Kasir.
- **Hitung HPP** — already exists: `products/[productId]/recipe/actions.ts` → `recalculateProductCost()` auto-recomputes `products.cost` from `product_recipes × ingredients.unit_cost` on every add/remove.
- **Cost Control (teori vs aktual)** — already exists in full inside `finance/page.tsx` (~line 187-256): COGS Teori (recipe-based) vs COGS Aktual (opening + pembelian − closing inventory), with a variance box and qualitative waste/efficiency notes. Not obvious from the nav alone — read the file before assuming this is missing.
- **Laporan COGS (per-produk/kategori breakdown)** — was genuinely missing; **built 2026-07-08** at `reports/cogs/page.tsx`, linked from the sidebar ("📐 Laporan COGS" in dashboard-shell.tsx) and cross-linked from `finance/page.tsx`'s Kontrol HPP section. Shows revenue/COGS/margin per category and per product, flags products with no HPP data (cost=0) and products under 20% margin.
- **Tren Harga bahan baku** — still missing, needs a new price-history table (`ingredients.unit_cost` only stores the current value, no history). Not started.
- Full double-entry **Akuntansi module** (COA, Jurnal, Neraca, Arus Kas, Target vs Aktual) — still entirely missing, and is a much bigger lift (new schema for accounts + journal lines, plus a decision on how it relates to the existing cash-basis Laba Rugi/Keuangan pages — replace or coexist?). Not started; user chose to do Cost Control/HPP first, accounting module "menyusul" (comes after).
- **Operasional gaps** not yet addressed: formal Pembelian (purchasing) records beyond the existing `expenses` category tagging, Supplier & Hutang (accounts payable) tracking — no supplier table exists yet.

**Modul Akuntansi selesai dibangun.** Ringkasan:

**Schema baru** (3 migration file, belum di-apply ke Supabase — perlu Anda paste manual seperti biasa):
- `20260708300000_accounting_core.sql` — Daftar Akun (COA), Jurnal (entries+lines double-entry), auto-seed 15 akun standar per toko
- `20260708300100_checkout_void_journal_posting.sql` — auto-posting jurnal dari penjualan & void transaksi
- `20260708300200_budgets.sql` — tabel anggaran untuk Target vs Aktual

**Auto-posting terpasang di:**
