The KasirKu project uses a hosted Supabase project (URL in `.env.local`), but `npx supabase migration list --linked` fails with LegacyProjectNotLinkedError — the CLI is not linked on this machine.

**Why:** New files in `supabase/migrations/` do not reach the database automatically; features silently fall back (e.g. missing RPCs return null) until applied.

**How to apply:** After adding a migration, remind the user (m.khamdannn91@gmail.com) to paste its SQL into the Supabase dashboard SQL Editor. As of 2026-07-03 all migrations through `20260702101100_self_order_rpc.sql` are applied (user ran the self-order RPC one manually that day; full customer QR → POS inbox flow verified E2E). `20260703100000_void_transaction_rpc.sql` was applied by the user the same day (void flow verified E2E: PIN gating, stock restore, activity log). `20260703110000_discounts_tax_checkout.sql` was applied by the user the same day (discount/PPN/service checkout verified E2E incl. CSV export columns). `20260703120000_open_bills.sql` was applied by the user the same day (save/update/load/pay-deletes cycle verified E2E). All migrations through 20260703120000 are applied. To verify whether an RPC exists, POST to `/rest/v1/rpc/<fn>` with correct param names; PGRST202 with an empty body is a false negative.

`20260704100000_stock_adjustments.sql` (adds `stock_adjustments` table for the stok opname/adjustment feature) was applied by the user on 2026-07-04. All migrations through 20260704100000 are applied.

`20260704200000_customers.sql` (adds `customers` table, `transactions.customer_id`, and redefines `checkout_transaction` with an 8th optional `p_customer_id` param) was applied by the user on 2026-07-04. All migrations through 20260704200000 are applied.

`20260704300000_low_stock_threshold.sql` (adds `min_stock` to `products` and `ingredients` for the low-stock notification feature) was applied by the user on 2026-07-04. All migrations through 20260704300000 are applied.

`20260705100000_cashier_management.sql` (adds `reset_cashier_pin` RPC) was applied by the user on 2026-07-05. All migrations through 20260705100000 are applied.

As of 2026-07-08, migrations `20260706100000_payroll.sql` through `20260707100000_ticket_checkin.sql` status is unconfirmed (not verified this session). `20260708100000_link_self_order_checkout.sql` (redefines `checkout_transaction` with a 9th `p_self_order_ids uuid[]` param that marks self_orders 'selesai' and stamps `transactions.table_id` on checkout) was applied by the user on 2026-07-08 and verified E2E in browser preview: QR order → POS inbox "+ Ke Kasir" → checkout → self_order auto-flips to 'selesai' and disappears from the inbox with no manual "✓ Selesai" click needed. All migrations through 20260708100000 are applied.

`20260708200000_admin_panel.sql` (adds `public.admins` table + `private.is_admin()` + security-definer RPCs `admin_stats()`/`admin_list_businesses()` for the new read-only `/admin` superadmin panel, see [[project-purpose-saas-product]]) is NOT yet applied as of 2026-07-08 — confirmed via `fetch('/admin')` returning a 404 (`__next_error__`) for the logged-in test account, which is the expected "not authorized / RPC missing" fallback. After pasting it into the SQL Editor, the user must also seed themselves as admin: find their user id in Supabase Dashboard → Authentication → Users, then run `insert into public.admins (user_id) values ('<uuid>');` — there is no self-service way to become admin by design.

Three more migrations for the new accounting/mini-ERP module (see [[mini-erp-scope]]):
- `20260708300000_accounting_core.sql` — `accounts`, `journal_entries`, `journal_lines` tables, default COA seeded per business (trigger + backfill), `private.post_journal()` helper, `public.post_journal_entry()` manual-entry RPC. **Confirmed applied 2026-07-08**: Daftar Akun page shows all 15 seeded accounts for Toko Test Laporan, and a manual journal entry via the Jurnal page posted successfully and balanced.
- `20260708300100_checkout_void_journal_posting.sql` — redefines `checkout_transaction` (same 9-param signature, now also auto-posts a sales journal entry) and `void_transaction` (posts a reversing entry). **Confirmed applied and working 2026-07-08**: did a real POS sale (Roti Bakar, INV-20260708-0003, Rp19.058) and it auto-posted "Penjualan INV-20260708-0003" — debit Kas & Bank / credit Pendapatan Penjualan Rp19.058, no HPP lines since Roti Bakar has no recipe cost yet (expected). Neraca then showed Total Aset = Total Modal (Laba Berjalan) = Rp19.058, balanced.
- `20260708300200_budgets.sql` — `public.budgets` table for the Target vs Aktual report. Applied alongside 300100 per the user; not separately exercised yet (no budget has been set through the UI) but the table existing is implied by the successful accounting_core + checkout migrations going in without error.

Still unverified: void auto-reversal, expense (`finance` addExpense) auto-posting, and the Anggaran/budgets UI actually saving+reading a target.
